text:
auditor_jane: Hi team — auditor follow-up: we need artefacts proving the RBAC rollback that happened last week and the KMS key unwrap logs tied to the incident. Can you share chain-of-custody and any triggered alerts?

samir: hi @auditor_jane — filing what we have. quick Q: do you want the full k8s audit stream or just the change and rollback events?

lisa: lean answer: rollback patch, PR link, and audit snapshots for the service accounts affected + KMS decrypt attempts. that should satisfy the control mapping for access-change/authorization controls.

auditor_jane: PR + snapshots + KMS logs please. also a short note mapping artifacts to SOC2 control CC6 and evidence filename conventions.

maria-oncall: tagging runbook: oncall created incident INC-2026-214 and we executed rollback per runbook v2.1. I can export the timeline and attach the signed handoff.

samir: collecting: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/5271 
Commit: 9b7d2c3
Rollback command we ran (kubectl):
```bash
kubectl -n inference rollout undo deployment/model-serve --to-revision=42
```

lisa: copying relevant audit snippets below (sanitized):
```json
{"kind":"Event","user":"svc-model-deploy","action":"patch","resource":"rolebinding/model-service-read","ts":"2026-06-09T14:02:11Z"}
{"kind":"Event","user":"samir","action":"patch","resource":"rolebinding/model-service-read","ts":"2026-06-09T14:05:02Z"}
{"kind":"Event","user":"maria-oncall","action":"rollback","resource":"deployment/model-serve","ts":"2026-06-09T14:07:45Z"}
```

lisa: KMS logs (short window):
```text
2026-06-09T14:06:00Z | keyId=projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/infra/cryptoKeys/rdw-main | action=AsymmetricDecrypt | principal=svc-model-deploy | status=OK
2026-06-09T14:06:07Z | keyId=... | action=AsymmetricDecrypt | principal=devops-bot | status=DENIED
```

auditor_jane: good — can you include the KMS key rotation metadata and the envelope key IDs that were used? we need to demonstrate key provenance for the timeframe.

samir: key rotation doc: keys/rdw-main rotated 2026-02-03, rotation-id=rot-20260203-01. Envelope IDs in logs: env-3f2a and env-3f2b. I'll export the key metadata from KMS and add a signed note.

maria-oncall: onboarding note: we followed the incident playbook (security/incident-handbook#rollback-flow). I created a signed artifact in S3 at s3://redwood-evidence/INC-2026-214/forensic_manifest.json and triggered the evidence-bot upload.

[evidence-bot]: uploaded s3://redwood-evidence/INC-2026-214/{manifest.json,rbac_snapshot.json,kms_logs_snippet.txt,runbook_handoff.txt}

auditor_jane: perfect. please also map each file to our control matrix: (1) rbac_snapshot.json => control CC6.2 change approval trace; (2) kms_logs_snippet.txt + manifest.json => CC7.1 key management provenance; (3) runbook_handoff.txt => CC4.3 incident response evidence.

lisa: done — I'll attach a one-page mapping doc and a brief narrative: why the rollback happened, who approved it, and evidence chain. ETA 30m.

samir: one more note re vuln triage: the change was rolled back after we saw a spike in model mem growth; root cause TBD (instrumenting now). I've linked the vuln ticket: VULN-2026-88. That ticket will contain followup fixes; will include status in evidence package.

auditor_jane: thanks — for the SOC2 binder we also need a signed statement from the engineer who performed the rollback. can someone add a signed Slack or a short GPG-signed note?

maria-oncall: I posted the signed handoff to the S3 manifest and also added a short GPG-signed blob there: s3://redwood-evidence/INC-2026-214/maria_signed_handoff.asc

lisa: mapping doc uploaded: s3://redwood-evidence/INC-2026-214/evidence_mapping_SOC2_v1.pdf 

samir: double-check: are we comfortable with redaction level? logs were sanitized to remove unrelated principals and token fragments. we kept service accounts and key ids.

auditor_jane: that's fine, we just need key identifiers, timestamps, and principal names. thank you. final ask: can you produce a short timeline CSV (ts,event,user,artifact_link) for the audit file?

samir: generating timeline.csv now, will include links to each S3 object and the PR. uploading in 10m.

[evidence-bot]: uploaded s3://redwood-evidence/INC-2026-214/timeline.csv

auditor_jane: received. this closes follow-up A. We'll review and reach out if we need correlate traces with the SIEM. Appreciate the fast turnaround. :thumbsup:
